votes.motion: Close the public hearing on RDA Budget Amendment No. 1 for Fiscal Year 2023-24 and defer action to later on in the agenda.
votes.description: The Board closed the public hearing regarding the proposed budget amendment and deferred formal action to later in the meeting.

votes.motion: Approve the meeting minutes of May 9, 2023; September 12, 2023; and October 10, 2023.
votes.description: The Board approved the official minutes from three prior RDA meetings.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 15 of 2023 RDA Budget Amendment No. 1 for Fiscal Year 2023-24 only for the item shown on the motion sheet.
votes.description: The Board adopted a resolution amending the RDA's final budget for FY 2023-24 to transfer funds to a City grant account for improved tracking and compliance reporting while keeping affordable housing use the same.
